static_traits.name: Gao Rui
static_traits.social_status: Tense relationships with colleagues due to feelings of inadequacy; has several close friends, but feels uncomfortable discussing self-doubt and avoids it
static_traits.medical_history: No obvious physical illness history; has not yet received psychotherapy; similar self-doubt issues began about a year ago
static_traits.language_features: Clear logic, fluent expression, high cooperation; able to specifically describe emotions and bodily reactions (e.g. 'stomach in knots, panic'); able to self-reflect

basic_info.main_problem: Although the 5th-grade students like me very much, I still feel other teachers are better than me, causing self-doubt and inferiority.
basic_info.core_demands: These feelings of self-doubt have affected my confidence in the classroom and caused daily-life stress, so I decided to seek counseling.

core_beliefs: I am not as good as others

special_situations.event: At a faculty meeting, a colleague is publicly praised for an innovative project
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I have not been recognized or have not produced creative achievements, it means I am not capable enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Doubling comparisons with others, self-blaming and pursuing perfection to make up for 'inadequacy'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am never that creative; I am not as good as her / him.

special_situations.event: Receives work feedback (especially when not entirely positive)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If feedback is not completely positive, it proves I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly replays the negative parts and ignores positive evaluations, down-weighting own strengths
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: See, I am still no good.

special_situations.event: Interacting with colleagues who are recognized or perform excellently / observing others' performance
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others do better, it means I fail and am worse than them
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces in-depth interaction with colleagues to avoid comparison, privately ruminating on comparison results
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are just naturally stronger than me; I am not worthy of recognition.

special_situations.event: When self-evaluating classroom and teaching performance
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only doing the best / perfectly counts as competent; otherwise it is failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Sets excessively high standards and excessive self-criticism to drive self-improvement
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If not the best, it equals failure.

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be seen and recognized, affirming one's value and ability as a teacher
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being negated and belittled in comparisons, experiencing shame and failure
defense_goal: Avoiding being criticized or negated through perfection-seeking and self-blame
Keeps some distance from colleagues to reduce the risk of exposing shortcomings

object_relations.self_representation: A not-good-enough teacher needing to constantly prove oneself
object_relations.object_representation: More accomplished colleagues/authorities who would judge oneself

object_relations.self_representation: A teacher liked by students but still worrying about 'being unworthy of' recognition
object_relations.object_representation: Schools/peer groups that hold the standards of evaluation

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites one to look for counter-evidence and emphasizes one's achievements and strengths
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tends to talk about facts in an objectified, abstract manner, downplaying emotional experience and the subjective feeling of self-worth
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Steady tone, focusing on facts and logic, few emotional words; responds with generalized statements, avoiding deeply touching feelings of inferiority/shame

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When colleagues' praise and comparison scenarios are mentioned
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Equating others' success with negation of one's self-worth
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Emphasizing 'they have better talent / resources' in a helpless and self-deprecating tone, avoiding exploring one's own feelings and diverse evaluation standards

manifestations: Over-binds self-worth to external recognition and comparison outcomes
Experiencing one's own efforts as 'seeming not good enough' when others are praised
Still invaded by self-doubt thoughts even when relaxing by the lake on weekends
outcomes: Decreased classroom confidence and affected work performance
Tense relationships with colleagues, emotional anxiety and shame

contact_model.definition: The individual has poor self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Frequently self-judging with 'I am not good enough', lowering the weight of positive feedback
Overly cautious when interacting with colleagues and in self-evaluation, afraid of exposing weaknesses

contact_model.definition: The individual turns the energy originally meant to be directed outward onto themselves, turning the force that could have been expressed outwardly/used to seek help into self-restraint and self-blame.
manifestations: Unwilling to discuss self-doubt with friends, internalizing stress as self-blame
Digesting anxiety and tension alone on weekends rather than seeking support

positive_force: Students' and parents' positive feedback and fondness for the class
Having self-reflective ability and willingness to actively seek help (seeking counseling)
Has several contactable close friends as potential support
negative_force: Thinking habits of perfectionism and excessive social comparison
Tends to ignore positive evidence and magnify negative cues
High dependence on external recognition makes confidence fragile
Relationships with colleagues are strained due to inferiority, further reducing support and resources

target_behavior.behavior: Self-doubt and anxiety triggered by repeated social comparison
antecedent: Seeing colleagues praised or showcasing results
Interacting with colleagues about work progress
Receives teaching feedback (especially when not entirely positive)
Intrusive comparison thoughts when trying to relax alone on weekends
target_behavior.core_reason: Perfectionist tendency and binding self-worth to external comparison and recognition
target_behavior.function: Avoids failure and shame (through avoiding colleague interaction and self-reproach, as 'self-protection'), and tries to obtain external validation through higher standards
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased classroom confidence, affected teaching performance; tense relationships with colleagues; weekend leisure interrupted by persistent stress and rumination; psychosomatic reactions such as stomach tightness and panic
